title: Normalized field scalar reduction comparison data
statement: For field-scalar system data $c,H$ [def-sp-field-scalar-system-data], reduction data means the completed coefficient basis and derived finite-power coordinate comparison, together with the natural ordinary isomorphism between completed scalar extension followed by reduction and reduction followed by whole-system scalar extension [det-sp-reduction-tower-normalized]. On local generators its forward map sends $(x\otimes s)\otimes b$ to $(x\otimes1)\otimes\overline s b$ and its inverse sends $(x\otimes a)\otimes b$ to $(x\otimes1)\otimes\overline a b$. The basis columns are the same integral vectors used in the system data. It also includes a natural isomorphism between the corresponding functors into the ordinary derived category of whole strict systems; on every K-flat representative its composite with the reduction and exact-extension counits is the localization of this very ordinary cochain isomorphism, composed with the completed-scalar counit. Completed scalar extension is the existing normalized scalar model [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. This defines the data and its normalized representative equation; it does not assert existence.
